name: github-ops
description: GitHub operations and merge-gate workflows paired with GitHub's official remote MCP toolset.

interface.longDescription: Operate repositories, commits, pull requests, Actions, releases, Dependabot, and pre-merge gates with the supplied GitHub Ops workflow and GitHub's official remote MCP toolset. Personal packaging maintained by travnie; not an official GitHub plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use GitHub Ops to inspect this repository, make the requested change, and verify the resulting PR or checks.
